ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central regions of both lobes consist of high-intensity contiguous white areas; low-intensity black banding follows the trailing edge and the lower peduncle-attachment region; multiple low-intensity circular focal spots are distributed across the high-intensity zones, particularly concentrated on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 65 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations visible along the entire trailing edge; irregular larger-amplitude peaks located near the outer tips and the median notch area.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edges moving from the tips toward the median notch; outer edges show a slight convex sweep toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular, dark-bordered pixel clusters (scars) distributed throughout the white surfaces; highest density of these clusters occurs on the medial-lower region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, unaligned vertical and diagonal dark linear marks detected on the right lobe and near the center-right of the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, high-relief cluster of biological material (barnacle colonization) localized on the outer tip of the left lobe; smaller similar cluster on the right lobe tip; dark parasitic or impact scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The left fluke tip exhibits a significant jagged extension beyond the standard geometric profile due to dense biological encrustation.
